features.item: A housing with a grip portion for gripping and an electrically operated vacuum generating device
The grip portion is a hollow body
Exhaust air from the vacuum generating device is guided through the grip portion to an air outlet
A sound-damping device is arranged in the grip portion
A grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping device in grip portion

A vacuum handling apparatus comprising a suction plate with carrier plate and seal, and a grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping device
The grip portion is at least partially lined with sound-damping material
The vacuum generating device is arranged completely in a first housing portion
A sound-reducing device is arranged in the first housing portion or the first housing portion is lined with sound-reducing material
The grip portion is elongated between the first housing portion and a second housing portion, with air outlet on the second housing portion
An air collection screw arranged upstream of the grip portion in the first housing portion for collecting exhaust air
Bent or curved air baffles downstream of the grip portion for guiding exhaust air to the air outlet
A battery coupling point on the second housing portion with air baffles directing exhaust air away from the battery coupling point
The grip unit and suction plate are releasably connected via a coupling device
The grip unit has a suction opening fluidically connected to a suction chamber delimited by the suction plate

claims.quote: a handling apparatus (3) including gripping means (19) thereon for removing a selected printing plate from the storage container and applying it to a selected plate cylinder
claims.note: The reference discloses a handling apparatus with gripping means for plates, but it does not specify a 'vacuum handling apparatus' or a 'suction plate'.

claims.quote: said handling apparatus includes a plate holding means (17), said plate holding means comprising a rotary drive (21) and suction grippers coupled for rotary movement to said rotary drive.
claims.note: The reference mentions 'suction grippers' as part of a plate holding means, which implies a suction plate, but it does not explicitly describe a 'carrier plate' or a 'seal fastened to the carrier plate and extending around it'.
The reference does not describe a 'grip unit according to claim 1' of the subject invention.
This reference does not describe a grip unit and suction plate being releasably connected via a coupling device.

claims.quote: The system of claim 1, wherein said handling apparatus includes a plate holding means (17), said plate holding means comprising a rotary drive (21) and suction grippers coupled for rotary movement to said rotary drive.
claims.note: The reference discloses suction grippers as part of the plate holding means, which implies they generate a vacuum to hold an object. However, it does not explicitly mention a suction opening, a suction chamber, or the fluidic connection between them to generate a vacuum.

overall.why: This reference describes an automatic printing plate attachment system for rotary printing machines, which is a different technical field from a vacuum handling apparatus with a grip unit and suction plate. There are no overlapping features related to vacuum generation, grip design, or sound damping
